class.name: CollisionShape4D
class.brief_description: Allows adding 4D collision shapes in the scene.
class.description: CollisionShape4D is the 4D equivalent of [CollisionShape2D] and [CollisionShape3D]. It exists to allow placing 4D collision shapes in the scene, which are used by physics bodies. [b]Warning:[/b] Do not scale CollisionShape4D nodes, as it will cause problems with physics. Instead, change the size of the [Shape4D] resource it contains. The transformation basis of a CollisionShape4D node should always be orthonormal, meaning unscaled and unskewed.

method.name: get_ancestor_collision_object
method.description: Returns the ancestor [CollisionObject4D] node that owns this CollisionShape4D. If this node is not in the scene tree, this will return [code]null[/code]. If this node is in the scene tree, but there is no ancestor CollisionObject4D, this will return the global static body, which is a special object that represents the static world; freeing this node will cause a crash.

method.name: get_collision_layer_value
method.description: Returns whether or not the specified layer of the [member collision_layer] is enabled, given a [param layer_number] between 1 and 32. In 4D, collision layers are per-shape, unlike [method CollisionObject3D.get_collision_layer_value] which is per-object.

method.name: get_collision_mask_value
method.description: Returns whether or not the specified layer of the [member collision_mask] is enabled, given a [param layer_number] between 1 and 32. In 4D, collision masks are per-shape, unlike [method CollisionObject3D.get_collision_mask_value] which is per-object.

method.name: get_hypervolume
method.description: Returns the hypervolume of the shape in quartic meters, using the shape's [method Shape4D.get_hypervolume] function.

method.name: get_nearest_global_point
method.description: Returns the point in global space that is nearest to the given point in global space, using the shape's [method Shape4D.get_nearest_point] function.

method.name: get_support_global_point
method.description: Returns the point in global space that is the farthest in the given direction, known as the support point, using the shape's [method Shape4D.get_support_point] function. This is commonly used in collision detection algorithms.

method.name: get_surface_volume
method.description: Return the surface volume of the shape in cubic meters, using the shape's [method Shape4D.get_surface_volume] function. [b]Note:[/b] This method may not give the correct result if the shape node is scaled non-uniformly. It is best practice to not scale physics nodes; instead scale the shape resource attached to the physics shape node.

method.name: has_global_point
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the shape contains the given point in global space. Points exactly on the surface are considered inside.

method.name: has_local_point
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the shape contains the given point in local space. Points exactly on the surface are considered inside.

method.name: set_collision_layer_value
method.description: Based on [param value], enables or disables the specified layer in the [member collision_layer], given a [param layer_number] between 1 and 32. This simplifies editing this CollisionShape4D's collision layer compared to assigning the [member collision_layer] property directly. In 4D, collision layers are per-shape, unlike [method CollisionObject3D.set_collision_layer_value] which is per-object.

method.name: set_collision_mask_value
method.description: Based on [param value], enables or disables the specified layer in the [member collision_mask], given a [param layer_number] between 1 and 32. This simplifies editing this CollisionShape4D's collision mask compared to assigning the [member collision_mask] property directly. In 4D, collision masks are per-shape, unlike [method CollisionObject3D.set_collision_mask_value] which is per-object.

members.member: The physics layers this CollisionShape4D [b]is in[/b]. Collision shapes can exist in one or more of 32 different layers. See also [member collision_mask]. [b]Note:[/b] Shape A can detect a contact with shape B only if shape B is in any of the layers that shape A scans. See [url=$DOCS_URL/tutorials/physics/physics_introduction.html#collision-layers-and-masks]Collision layers and masks[/url] in the documentation for more information. [b]Note:[/b] To avoid duplicating project settings, the 4D layer names are the same as the 3D layer names. This is purely cosmetic.

The physics layers this CollisionShape4D [b]scans[/b]. Collision objects can scan one or more of 32 different layers. See also [member collision_layer]. [b]Note:[/b] Shape A can detect a contact with shape B only if shape B is in any of the layers that shape A scans. See [url=$DOCS_URL/tutorials/physics/physics_introduction.html#collision-layers-and-masks]Collision layers and masks[/url] in the documentation for more information. [b]Note:[/b] To avoid duplicating project settings, the 4D layer names are the same as the 3D layer names. This is purely cosmetic.
The [PhysicsMaterial] of the body, which determines the collision response of the surface, including friction and bounciness/restitution.
The [Shape4D] resource that defines the shape of this collision shape node.
